meta.title: TraceCart — Get it there.
meta.description: Sourcing and cross-border logistics for landlocked and difficult-to-reach markets. Tell us what needs to move — we'll work out the route.

quoteBar.whatPlaceholder: Describe the product or tool in your own words: what it's for, the brand or model if you know them, how many… or just add a photo.
quoteBar.disclaimer: We find the product, then a person from the team replies with a delivered price. A free account is needed to see the results.
quoteBar.submittedBody: Someone from the team will reply to confirm the product and ask where it needs to go.
quoteBar.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB max
quoteBar.photoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of 5 MB or less.
quoteBar.needWhat: Describe the product or add a photo.
quoteBar.pickHint: Pick the closest one; we check the exact model, price and delivery before we reply.
quoteBar.noneTitle: We couldn't find this product online.
quoteBar.noneBody: That's fine: send the request and someone will look for it for you.

quoteBar.limited: Partial search today: someone will complete it.
